description: This file contains utility functions and macros for jemalloc, including assertion handling, message output, string conversion, and formatted printing functions, with specific focus on avoiding memory allocation during error reporting.

methods.name: malloc_write
methods.description: Outputs a string message, using a custom callback if set, or defaulting to writemessage.

methods.name: buferror
methods.description: Provides a cross-platform wrapper for strerror_r, handling Windows and GNU-specific implementations.

methods.name: malloc_strtoumax
methods.description: Converts a string to uintmax_t with support for different bases and signs.

methods.name: malloc_vsnprintf
methods.description: Formats a string with variable argument list into a buffer, supporting various format specifiers.

methods.name: malloc_snprintf
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a buffer, wrapping malloc_vsnprintf.

methods.name: malloc_vcprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a callback function, avoiding memory allocation.

methods.name: malloc_cprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a callback function, with variable arguments.

methods.name: malloc_printf
methods.description: Prints formatted output to stderr, avoiding memory allocation.
